title: Fixed Open Offset Rafter and Central Aperture Roof Frame
description: One complete original open timber roof framework: eight full grounded posts with stone feet support a continuous peripheral octagonal bearing ring; eight inclined tangentially offset chord rafters form a cyclic overlapping arrangement around a real central polygonal aperture, with no central post or independent crown ring. Each rafter crosses an adjacent rafter at a different position along its sloping length. This is not the old radial yurt rafters terminating at a separate crown ring, not a planar hammerbeam portal, and not a roof-cover colour/count variant. All geometry authored for this whole frame. The roof is deliberately uncovered so the entire rafter organisation remains visible; no cover, walls or weather enclosure are promised. Three opaque PBR roles, metres Z up, complete horizontal bounds centred. Static artistic assembly only: crossings are fixed overlapping timber seats, not engineered joinery, reciprocal load analysis, construction instructions, tested load bearing or human-use safety. No rig, animation or interaction.
